channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula e Flávio empatam no 1º e no 2º turnos pela primeira vez no Datafolha
item.description: Just over three weeks before the 2026 elections, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in both the first round (39% to 35%) and the second round (46% to 44%), according to a Datafolha survey released on September 11. This is the first time in the institute's historical series that the two candidates tie in both rounds. Other candidates — Augusto Cury, Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and Romeu Zema — are statistically tied for third place within the margin of error.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 39% no 1º turno; Flávio marca 35%; Cury, 6%
item.description: Lula leads with 39% followed by Flavio Bolsonaro at 35% and Augusto Cury at 6%. Support for Lula and Flavio rose since the prior poll; Cury fell. 6% blank/null/none, 4% undecided.

item.title: Mendonça diz que celular de Vorcaro com mensagens de Moraes não está com ele, mas com a PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça told STF President Edson Fachin that the court’s office did not access Daniel Vorcaro’s phone, whose messages implicate Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The material remains under Federal Police custody, as ordered by Mendonça when he took over the case. Only a sealed envelope with extracted data is held by the court.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam tecnicamente no 2º turno
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on September 11, 2026 projects a technical tie in a second-round race between Lula, at 46%, and Flávio Bolsonaro, at 44%. The survey interviewed 2,002 people and matched the September 3 findings.

item.title: Leite é interrompido por Lula ao citar transposição do São Francisco
item.description: Lula interrupted governor Eduardo Leite during a speech about RS reconstruction works, rejecting comparisons to the São Francisco transposition. The president demanded faster use of R$ 6.5 billion from the Novo PAC and signed R$ 1.5 billion for Canoas drainage projects.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula são rejeitados por 46% dos eleitores, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied for the highest rejection rates, with 46% of voters ruling each out. Flávio's rate fell from 47%, while Lula's rose from 45%, with both shifts within the poll's margin of error.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha: colunistas do GLOBO analisam os resultados da corrida presidencial e nos estados
item.description: The Datafolha poll released Friday (April 25) maps the presidential race and projections in key states, analyzed by GLOBO columnists. The piece highlights an interactive GLOBO quiz to identify voter alignment and discusses how the Supreme Court crisis impacts the race. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are seen as the main beneficiaries of internal judicial conflicts.

item.title: Michelle critica decisão de Moraes e diz que restrição a visitas prejudica campanha ao Senado
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro criticized Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision rejecting the request to allow family members to remain at the residence during her absences, limiting visits to two hours twice a week. The former first lady claimed this restriction hinders her Senate campaign in the Federal District, where she leads voter intentions according to Datafolha poll. The defense of Jair Bolsonaro had requested family members' presence to care for him during house arrest and health issues.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 46% e Flávio Bolsonaro marca 44% no 2º turno
item.description: In a second-round poll, Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro 46% to 44%, a statistical tie within the two-point margin of error. Against four other opponents, Lula ranges from 45% to 48%, while they range from 37% to 43%. In the first round, Lula leads with 39%, followed by Flávio on 35% and Augusto Cury on 6%.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 39% no 1° turno, e Flávio Bolsonaro, 35%
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 35% of voting intentions, within the margin for a statistical tie. Augusto Cury ranks third with 6% in the survey conducted across 125 municipalities and registered with the TSE.

item.title: Datafolha: 50% desaprovam e 47% aprovam governo Lula
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 50% disapproval and 47% approval for President Lula’s administration, compared with 51% and 45% in the previous survey. Qualitative ratings stand at 42% negative and 32% positive. The survey interviewed 2,002 people from September 8 to 10, with a two-percentage-point margin of error.

item.title: Lula tem 46% no segundo turno contra 44% de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz Datafolha
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied in the second round at 46% to 44%, according to Datafolha. The result remained stable compared to the previous poll. The survey, registered with the TSE, interviewed 2,002 people with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula tem 46% em segundo turno contra Flávio Bolsonaro, que marca 44%
item.description: Datafolha shows Lula (PT) with 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 44% of voting intentions in a possible runoff, within the two-point margin of error. The figures are unchanged from the previous poll; 2,002 people were interviewed from September 8 to 11 amid developments in the Supreme Court crisis.

item.title: Datafolha, 2º turno: Lula, 46%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 44%
item.description: Datafolha poll released on September 11 shows Lula at 46% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 44% in a simulated runoff. The survey, commissioned by Globo and Folha, interviewed 2,002 people from September 8-10 with a ±2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Datafolha, 1º turno: Lula, 39%; Flávio Bolsonaro, 35%; Cury, 6%; Caiado, 4%; Renan, 3%; Zema, 2%
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on September 11 shows Lula leading with 39%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 35%. Augusto Cury trails at 6%, Ronaldo Caiado at 4%, with remaining candidates earning marginal support. The margin of error is 2 percentage points.

item.title: Celina Leão lidera com 40% das intenções ao governo do DF, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Celina Leão (PP) leading the race for governor of Brazil’s Federal District with 40% of voting intentions, ahead of Arruda (PSD) and Leandro Grass (PT), both at 17%. Without Arruda, whose candidacy was rejected by the Regional Electoral Court, Celina rises to 45% and Grass reaches 19%; the survey interviewed 910 voters from September 8 to 11, with a 3-point margin of error.

item.title: Haddad diz que é preciso tirar do STF quem estiver criando problemas
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) stated that STF justices responsible for irregularities should be removed from the court. The statement was made during an interview on Rádio Pop Aparecida, commenting on the Court's actions in the Banco Master case. The candidate advocates for the disclosure of investigation details.

item.title: Cruzeiro anuncia chegada por empréstimo de Viña, campeão da Libertadores
item.description: Cruzeiro announced the signing of Uruguayan defender Matías Viña, loaned from Flamengo until December 2026. The player, who has struggled with injuries and limited playing time in Rio, now seeks a fresh start at the Minas Gerais club. With the deal confirmed, Viña is eligible for the Brazilian league, making his debut this Saturday against Santos.

item.title: TSE rejeita registro de candidatura de Marçal à Presidência
item.description: The TSE has a majority to reject Pablo Marçal's (PRTB) presidential candidacy registration. Justice Estela Aranha cited his ineligibility until 2032 and questioned whether he joined the party within the legal deadline; Dias Toffoli and Floriano de Azevedo Marques have yet to vote.

item.title: Ex-governador Gladson Cameli está inelegível e não pode ser candidato ao Senado, decide TRE-AC
item.description: The Acre Regional Electoral Court unanimously rejected former governor Gladson Cameli's Senate candidacy registration, ruling that his collegiate criminal conviction by the STJ makes him ineligible under Brazil's Clean Record Act. His defense is appealing to the STF, arguing that the conviction may still be overturned and that he was denied a second-instance review, but the reporting judge said electoral ineligibility applies automatically after a collegiate criminal conviction without requiring a final judgment.

item.title: Dark Horse: prefeitura consulta STF sobre rompimento de contrato com ONG
item.description: The mayor of São Paulo, Ricardo Nunes, announced plans to file a lawsuit with the Supreme Court to challenge the termination of a contract with the NGO Instituto Conhecer Brasil, following a ruling by Minister Flávio Dino declaring the institute inactive commercially.

item.title: Em pior semana, campanha de Lula ganha respiro com volta da relação entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Master às manchetes e freio de arrumação no PT
item.description: Lula's reelection campaign gained relief as the Banco Master investigations returned to headlines, hurting Flávio Bolsonaro. The institutional crisis at the STF and falling polls had consolidated a technical tie in the second round. The government's response, including keeping Andrei Rodrigues at the PF and new operations, eased some pressure on the PT.

item.title: Datafolha: Tarcísio tem 49% contra 29% de Haddad em SP
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on October 11 shows Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading with 49% of voting intentions against 29% for Fernando Haddad (PT) in São Paulo. Compared to the previous survey on August 21, Tarcísio gained 4 points while Haddad advanced 2 points.

item.title: Petistas e bolsonaristas já veem Cleitinho como "imbatível" em Minas
item.description: Both PT and Bolsonaro-aligned leaders in Minas Gerais already view Senator Cleitinho (Republicanos) as unbeatable for the October gubernatorial race. The strategy hinges on the idea that regardless of whether he faces a left-wing candidate like Patrus Ananias or Alexandre Kalil, or a right-wing candidate like Flávio Roscoe, the remaining votes would consolidate behind Cleitinho in a runoff. A Datafolha poll showed him rising five points to 37% (47% of valid votes), with projected victories of 54%-29% over Kalil and 59%-24% over Patrus.

item.title: Mendonça responde Edson Fachin e diz que já tirou sigilo do caso Master
item.description: Mendonça responds to Fachin by claiming the Master case secrecy has already been partially lifted, but says the order covers only the latest phase of Compliance Zero. Fachin and the PGR demanded full disclosure; Zanin asked for Vorcaro’s phone data, which Mendonça says is with the police. Investigations into Flávio Bolsonaro and Jaques Wagner remain sealed.

item.title: Oposição pede a Fachin quebra de sigilo de inquéritos das 'fake news' e de 'fraudes no INSS'
item.description: Rogério Marinho, campaign coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, asked STF President Edson Fachin to lift secrecy on inquiries related to fake news, digital militias, and INSS fraud. The request followed the release of documents in the Banco Master case revealing investigations into Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro tied to the film 'Dark Horse'. Fachin granted the PGR's request for secrecy removal in the Master case, and Marinho argued that greater transparency reduces selective leaks.

item.title: Empresas de Flávio Bolsonaro e ‘Careca do INSS’ dividem o mesmo endereço em Brasília, diz site
item.description: Companies linked to Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and the detained Antonio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as ‘Careca do INSS,’ reportedly share an address in Águas Claras, according to ICL Notícias. The outlet also alleges accounting and family ties, while lawyers deny that the office belongs to the accounting firm. The report does not by itself prove that Flávio Bolsonaro was involved in the investigated scheme.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral manda preservar posts de Nikolas sobre documento da PF
item.description: The Regional Electoral Court of Minas Gerais ordered Meta and X Brazil to preserve all data from posts by congressman Nikolas Ferreira (PL) related to an alleged fake Federal Police document. The investigation examines whether the lawmaker spread false content attributed to the PF, potentially constituting an electoral offense. The ruling aims to ensure the integrity of evidence in the judicial process.

item.title: ‘Resposta midiática’: advogado vê queda de sigilo pelo STF como reação a críticas sobre Mendonça
item.description: Lawyer Bruno Moura assesses that STF's disclosure of the Master case secrecy is a media response to criticism about Minister André Mendonça. The revelation investigates Flávio Bolsonaro on suspicion of money laundering, currency evasion and passive corruption, with possible links to former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Autora brasiliense lança novo livro que celebra o Lago Paranoá neste sábado
item.description: Brasília-based author Nyedja Gennari launches her children's book 'The Legend of Paranoá Lake' on Saturday, September 12, commemorating the lake's 67th anniversary and Juscelino Kubitschek's 124th birthday. The free event features storytelling, indigenous performances, and regional music at the Clube do Exército.

item.title: Lula tem 48,8% contra 45,6% de Flávio no 2º turno no PA, diz pesquisa
item.description: AtlasIntel poll released on September 11, 2026 shows Lula (PT) at 48.8% versus Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 45.6% in a possible 2nd round presidential race in Pará. The survey also tested alternative scenarios with Caiado, Zema, and Renan Santos, all favoring Lula. In a 1st round scenario, Lula leads with 44.7% of voting intentions.

item.title: Petista aciona STF após denúncia de recursos dos EUA na campanha de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a lawsuit with the STF to investigate alleged foreign funding, particularly from the US-based Rockbridge Network, in Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) presidential campaign. The complaint is based on statements from candidate Renan Santos (Missão) and points to possible electoral irregularities such as vote buying and money laundering.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado na história da República
item.description: This article examines all Senate elections throughout Brazilian republican history, highlighting the first election in 1890 and the evolution of the electorate from approximately 300,000 voters to 158.7 million in 2026. It documents institutional transformations, constitutional changes and electoral reforms over 136 years of Brazilian democracy. The analysis spans from the imperial period to the present, focusing on Senate composition and citizen participation in national elections.

item.title: Nunes protocola queixa-crime contra Haddad por difamação e calúnia
item.description: Ricardo Nunes filed a criminal complaint against Fernando Haddad for defamation and slander during a televised debate, alleging that Haddad falsely linked São Paulo's debt and Wi-Fi contracts to the financing of the documentary Dark Horse about Jair Bolsonaro. Federal police are investigating potential irregularities in the contract between the city hall and Instituto Conhecer Brasil, suspecting public funds were used to finance the documentary production. Nunes denied any wrongdoing and stated that the State Audit Court is monitoring the case.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado em Santa Catarina
item.description: The page lists all Senate elections in Santa Catarina since 1889, highlighting winners, competitors, and gubernatorial candidacies. It includes valid vote counts and percentages, focusing on candidates with over 5% of votes in post-1945 elections. Official TSE data is used unless otherwise noted.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado em Sergipe
item.description: The page compiles information on all Senate elections held in Sergipe since 1889, highlighting elected candidates, runners-up, and governors who ran for Senate. Election results by year, including votes and percentages, are shown based on TSE data.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado em Pernambuco
item.description: The page compiles data on Senate elections in Pernambuco since 1889, including vote totals, winners and leading rivals, mainly from TSE databases. The excerpt highlights recent outcomes: Teresa Leitão won in 2022; Humberto Costa and Jarbas Vasconcelos in 2018; Fernando Bezerra Coelho in 2014; Armando Monteiro and Humberto Costa in 2010; and Jarbas Vasconcelos in 2006.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: Rio de Janeiro has held Senate elections since 1889, with detailed TSE data from 1945 onward. In 2022, Romário (PL) was elected with 36.13% of votes, followed by Alessandro Molon and Daniel Silveira. In 2018, Flávio Bolsonaro (PSL) and Arolde de Oliveira (PSD) won the two available seats.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado no Piauí
item.description: The Senate page compiles results for senatorial elections in Piauí since 1889, with detailed data beginning in 1945 and sourced from the TSE. In 2022, Wellington Dias (PT) won one seat with 51.34% of the vote, ahead of Joel Rodrigues (PP), who received 47.60%. The page also covers earlier contests, reelections, and candidacies by former governors.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado no Paraná
item.description: The page compiles Senate elections in Paraná since 1889, including winners, rivals, reelection bids, and gubernatorial candidacies, based mainly on TSE data. The excerpt details contests from 2006 to 2022, with results for 2010, 2014, 2018, and 2022.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado em Goiás
item.description: The page compiles elections for the Senate in Goiás since 1889, with detailed TSE data from 1945 onward. In 2022, Wilder Morais won a one-seat race with 799,022 votes, while Vanderlan Cardoso and Jorge Kajuru won the two seats contested in 2018.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado no Distrito Federal
item.description: The Federal Senate page, published on November 9, 2026, compiles Senate elections in the Federal District since 1986 using TSE data. It details winners, major challengers, reelection bids, and governors who ran for the Senate; the excerpt highlights 2010–2022.

item.title: Todas as eleições para o Senado no Ceará
item.description: The Senate page compiles all Ceará Senate elections since 1889, using TSE data from 1945 onward. Highlights include Camilo Santana (PT) in 2022 with 69.80%, Cid Gomes (PDT) and Eduardo Girão (PROS) in 2018, and Tasso Jereissati (PSDB) in 2014. Reelection bids and candidates with ≥5% of valid votes are listed by year.

item.title: PL tem plano para salvar Roscoe e tirar palanque de Lula do 2º turno em MG
item.description: Minas Gerais' Liberal Party is ramping up efforts to boost Flávio Roscoe's campaign and prevent Lula from gaining a statewide platform in a potential second round. The strategy involves mobilizing deputies and party members to redirect votes to the Bolsonarist candidate, while avoiding a direct confrontation with Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicans), who leads the polls.

item.title: STF julga recurso de Eduardo Bolsonaro contra condenação por coação
item.description: The STF's First Chamber began reviewing Eduardo Bolsonaro's appeal against a 4-year, 2-month sentence for coercion during the legal process. Moraes rejected declaração embargos, denied spontaneous confession and parliamentary immunity claims, upholding the June conviction. Voting ends September 18 with Cármen Lúcia, Zanin and Dino still to vote.

item.title: Lula tenta reagir a avanço de Flávio e sanciona PL para motoristas de app
item.description: Lula is backing the approval of popular measures, including MOVE financing for new vehicle purchases, as Flávio Bolsonaro advances in presidential polling. The move aims to boost the president’s standing and reshape his electoral narrative ahead of 2026.

item.title: 'HD do caso Master' vai de mensagens trocadas com Moraes à 'Turma do Vorcaro' e reúne quatro mil arquivos; entenda
item.description: STF Justice André Mendonça released approximately 4,000 files (26 GB) from the Master case, complying with Chief Justice Edson Fachin's order. The trove includes Federal Police reports, Coaf communications, and legal petitions, though investigations into Senators Flávio Bolsonaro and Jaques Wagner, plus funding for the 'Dark Horse' film, remain sealed.

item.title: Flávio diz que Mendonça 'está certo' em investigação sobre Dark Horse e pede abertura de sigilo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) said Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça is right in authorizing an investigation into his relationship with the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', avoiding holding him accountable for the decision. The presidential candidate emphasized that Mendonça is merely fulfilling his role as a judge.

item.title: “Mendonça está certo”, diz Flávio sobre inquérito
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that Minister André Mendonça is 'right' in authorizing the investigation against him in the Dark Horse case. He praised Mendonça for acting as an impartial judge and expressed admiration for the minister's stance. The statement was made on April 11th.

item.title: El Supremo de Brasil investiga al candidato presidencial Bolsonaro por corrupción
item.description: Brazil's Supreme Court is investigating presidential candidate Fávia Bolsonaro for money laundering, currency evasion, and corruption in the Master case, a major fraud linked to banker Daniel Vorcaro. The revelation comes less than three weeks before the October elections, in which Brazilians will elect the president, governors, and Congress. The investigation points to millions of dollars in payments made by Vorcaro to the candidate.
